title: Find Mica a Safe Route
story: Mica carries the relay battery. The crater rim blocks a direct crossing.
lesson: BFS uses a queue. Mark neighbors as seen when queued, and retain the path to each cell. Equal-cost steps make the first goal path shortest.
objective: Return a shortest list of [x,y] cells including start and goal. '#' is blocked. All fixtures have a reachable goal.
sample: [[0,0],[1,0],[1,1]] is two moves. grid[y][x] addresses the terrain.
hint: Queue (cell,path). Append each unseen open neighbor with path + [neighbor].
